scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @fluently/web && npm run build --workspace @fluently/admin
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p apps/web/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/admin/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p services/api/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/domain/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/content-schema/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/storage-web/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/curriculum/tsconfig.json
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run lint && npm run security:check && npm run content:validate
scripts.build:android: npm run build:web && npm run sync --workspace @fluently/android
